📖 Official Classic UNO Rules

1. Deal & Goal: Each player starts with 7 cards. Match the top card of the Discard Pile by Color, Number (0–9), or Action Symbol. First player to reach 0 cards wins the prize pool!
2. Action & Wild Cards (Official 2-Player Rules):
  • Skip (⊘): Opponent loses their turn — you play again immediately!
  • Reverse (⇄): Acts like Skip in 2-player matches — you play again immediately!
  • Draw Two (+2): Opponent draws 2 cards and loses their turn.
  • Wild (W): Switch the active suit to Red, Yellow, Green, or Blue.
  • Wild Draw Four (+4): Pick the next suit color, opponent draws 4 cards, and you play again!
3. 10-Second "UNO!" Rule (When 1 Card Is Left): When you have 2 cards left and throw 1 card so that 1 card remains, a live 10-second UNO countdown starts immediately! You must click 🔥 UNO! within 10 seconds—if you don't click UNO in time, you automatically pick up +2 penalty cards!

✈️ How to Play Aviator

1. Place Your Bet Before Takeoff: Use one or both independent betting panels (`Bet Panel #1` & `Bet Panel #2`) to lock in your stake during the 5-second countdown before the plane takes off.
2. Watch the Lucky Plane Climb: As the red aircraft ascends, the multiplier starts at 1.00x and climbs higher. Your potential payout equals your Bet × Current Multiplier.
3. Cash Out Before It Flies Away: Tap CASH OUT (or configure Auto Cash Out in the `Auto` tab) before the plane flies away! If the plane flies away before you cash out, your bet is lost.

👑 Official Ludo 1vs1, 1vsPC & Tournament Rules

1. Universal Ludo King Core Rules:
  • All 4 Tokens Start Inside Base: All 4 Red and 4 Yellow tokens start locked inside their home yards.
  • Roll 6 to Unlock: You can only take a token out of the yard onto the starting square when you roll a 6 on the dice.
  • Max 2 Consecutive 6s: Rolling a 6 grants a bonus roll, up to a strict maximum of two consecutive 6s (you can only get 6 two times continuously).
  • Safe Stars & Capturing: The 8 Star squares (★) are safe zones. Landing on an opponent's token on any non-safe square captures it back to its yard and awards you a Bonus Roll!
  • Crown Home Goal: Reach the center Crown Home with an exact roll (awards a Bonus Roll). First player to bring all 4 tokens home wins!
2. Ludo 1vs1 & 1vsPC Modes: Play live 1vs1 battles or instant automatic 1vsPC matches. Use the board tokens or the 4 Quick-Pawn buttons below the board to move!
3. Ludo Tournaments:
  • Entry & Details: Click any Active or Upcoming Tournament to see the Last Date of Entry, Entry Price, Rules, and When the Tournament Begins.
  • 24-Hour Match Notification: Once you take part, you will receive a notification inside your Tournament tab 24 hours before your scheduled match with your opponent and match time.
  • Past Played Matches: Track all your past played tournament matches and results directly inside the Tournament tab.

📖 1vs1 Math Speed Duel Rules

1. Entry Fee & Prize Pool (10% Platform Fee): Both players pay the same entry fee (same as UNO). The combined pool (2 × Entry Fee) has a 10% platform fee deducted, and the winner takes the entire remaining 90% net prize!
2. 10 Math Questions Each: Both players receive the exact same set of 10 arithmetic questions (Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, and mixed equations).
3. Only Right Answers Count (Most Right Answers + Fastest Time Wins): Only right answers are counted toward your score! The player who gives more right answers out of 10 always wins—for example, if Player 1 gets 9/10 right in 30s and Player 2 gets 7/10 right in 20s, Player 1 wins because 9 right answers beats 7 right answers. Completion time (`0.01s` precision) decides the winner when both players have the same number of right answers!

🔗 How Relative Referral Distance Works

Commission level is determined by the distance from the depositing member, not by a permanent account label:

Chain Example: Agent A (You) → Member B (Rahul) → Member C (Aman) → Member D (Priya)
When Member D (Priya) deposits ₹1,000:
  • Member C (Aman) is Level 1 to D → receives 7% (₹70)
  • Member B (Rahul) is Level 2 to D → receives 6% (₹60)
  • Agent A (You) is Level 3 to D → receives 5% (₹50)
  • Anyone above Agent A (Levels 4–7) → receives 4% → 3% → 2% → 1%
💡 If Member C also refers 10 new members, C gets Level 1 (7%) on their deposits, B gets Level 2 (6%), and You (Agent A) get Level 3 (5%)!

⚙️ Commission Rule & Fraud Controls

Admin Panel Synced

📱 Your Referral Invite QR Code

📖 7-Level Referral & Commission Guide

1. 7-Level Commission Structure (Max 28%): Level 1: 7% • Level 2: 6% • Level 3: 5% • Level 4: 4% • Level 5: 3% • Level 6: 2% • Level 7: 1%.
2. Example on ₹1,000 Deposit: L1 gets ₹70, L2 gets ₹60, L3 gets ₹50, L4 gets ₹40, L5 gets ₹30, L6 gets ₹20, and L7 gets ₹10 (Total = ₹280 across 7 levels).
3. Relative Distance Rule: Commission level is determined by the distance from the depositing member upward through the referral chain, up to 7 levels.
4. Idempotent & Auditable Ledger: Only settled qualifying deposits generate commission. Promotional credits, failed payments, chargebacks, self-referrals, or duplicate deposit event IDs are automatically rejected.
